description:
A low-poly model of a restyled American compact sedan from the late '90s in a police package.
I decided to make a police car, inspired by the base model used in MW and up until the dawn of PS2 era. I know the car represents full-size police sedan in the game, but due gameplay it looks more like something much smaller. I wanted to simplify the process, so I chose a Murphy '92 as the platform for the restyle, with minimal changes—the hood and headlights.

PS - If that Hommage livery is too exesive, use more nutral from '92 model. All the components are interchangable - there's not to many.
